# Pixel Elevator Panel (Floors 1–6)

A dependency-free, offline browser app with a pixel-art elevator panel.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

- Press floor buttons **1–6** to queue a destination.
- The car moves one floor per second toward the next queued floor.
- The display shows the current floor and direction (Up / Down / Idle).
- Doors open automatically on arrival and close after a short delay.

## Controls

All floor buttons are keyboard-accessible: `Tab` to focus, `Enter` or `Space` to activate. Buttons have descriptive `aria-label` attributes.

## Architecture

- `index.html` — markup and layout.
- `styles.css` — pixel-art styling, responsive layout, focus/hover/pressed states.
- `app.js` — elevator state engine (queue, tick loop, direction, doors) and rendering.

## Notes

- No imports, packages, network requests, or external assets.
- Uses `addEventListener` only; no inline handlers.
- Includes `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` rule.
- Works from 360px wide upward.
